stance_basis: paraphrase describing land acquisition problems along Parnell Avenue as a concern
summary: W. F. Szczepanski, a private citizen from 1551 Klein Avenue, testified at the March 25, 1969 Corridor Location Public Hearing, raising concerns about land acquisition problems along Parnell Avenue. The Wisconsin Department of Transportation responded by noting that right-of-way negotiations and acquisition had been halted in March 1973 pending completion of the Final EIS.
complaint_summary: Szczepanski stated that there would be land acquisition problems along Parnell Avenue.
